card.name: Linking words in geography and reactions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, and, of, 's) right after a place name like Eastern Siberia or a railway route, with the strongest hits there. It also fires on 'of' and commas after reaction terms such as incidence, degree or edema.

modes.label: Geography linkers
modes.description: A linking word follows a region or route name in text about Russia, China or railways.
modes.example: Traversing Eastern Siberia and<< the>> Russian Far East, the 4

modes.label: Reaction wording
modes.description: 'of' or a comma follows words like incidence, degree or edema in skin and local reaction text.
modes.example: accompanied by a variable degree<< of>> itching.

card.writes: It seems to push toward border and region words, mostly Chinese ones like 边界 and 中方, and away from unrelated words.
card.plain: It fires on small joining words after place names, especially Siberia and China, and also in some skin reaction wording.
